userPrompt: Give me a recipe idea using eggs and spinach.
responseText:
**Spinach & Egg Skillet** (10 minutes, serves 1–2)

- Sauté a big handful of fresh spinach in olive oil or butter with a pinch of salt, garlic powder, and red pepper flakes until wilted (≈2 min).  
- Make two small wells, crack in 2–3 eggs.  
- Cover and cook on low until whites set but yolks are still runny (3–4 min).  
- Finish with black pepper, a squeeze of lemon, and optional crumbled feta or grated parmesan.

High-protein, one-pan, zero waste. Eat straight from the skillet.
